Go elsewhere.
Mar 2024 • Friends
We were on a tour with Distant Journeys and had to have the set menu. It was about average at best. My wife ordered her meal separately, so the meal between us all was set for 4 people between 32 of us so our table only got enough for 3. Throughout the meal my wife's lunch never even materialised 🤷‍♂️
So she had to snack in the coach afterwards🙈. Our tour guide told us this was one of the best restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City. 
What a massive Anti Climax. Never again.
